title: Implement convected coordinate functions
objective: Implement three functions in symbolic/convected.py: compute_reference_metric (returns δ_IJ for Cartesian), compute_convected_metric (returns g_IJ = F^T F), and green_lagrange_convected (returns E = 0.5*(g - G)). Raise UnsupportedError for non-Cartesian coordinates.
implementation_steps: Read existing kinematics.py to understand how g = C is already computed
Implement compute_reference_metric(coords='cartesian') → returns sp.eye(3), raises UnsupportedError for other values with Plan B pointer
Implement compute_convected_metric(F) → returns F.T @ F (= C_IJ)
Implement green_lagrange_convected(g, G) → returns sp.Rational(1,2) * (g - G)
acceptance_criteria: compute_reference_metric('curvilinear') raises UnsupportedError with Plan B phase B2 pointer
compute_convected_metric(F) returns F^T @ F for any 3x3 F
At F=I: g = G = I, E = 0
verification_commands: uv run python -c "from mechdsl.symbolic.convected import compute_reference_metric; print(compute_reference_metric())"

cases: Known simple shear → g = C (hand calc)

risks: Low risk: trivial implementation wrapping existing SymPy operations. No numerical integration or Taichi kernels involved.
